fieldValues.title: The page
fieldValues.summary: The page's blocks in order, each showing the fields the site draws. Click a field and type to change it; drag a block by its edge to move it, a group's items move with it.
fieldValues.explanation: Each block shows only the fields its View puts on the site, in that order; the first reads as its heading. Edits save as you leave the field. Dragging moves a block (a group with its items) before or after another; an item stays inside its group.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Explain that the page is drawn from the site's own blocks, so what shows here is what the site renders; editor-only fields (briefs, keys, settings) are in the inspector.
